reviews.text: Excellent service, attentive and very professional, thank you ❤️

This was our first visit with our cat Choupette. We received a very warm welcome, the clinic was very clean, and the staff were young and very professional. It's clear they take good care of the animals, and we were very satisfied with our visit.

And there's free parking in the back.

First time at Royal Vet, safe to say my experience has been the most delightful. Very friendly team! Special thanks to Cindy and Sarah for the throrough consultation and detailed explanations.

Luna got her good girl stamp today!🥰🥰
Great team, great place
I got an appointment quickly for a minor emergency: the welcome was very warm, I felt valued, and each member of staff was very competent. I was very satisfied and I recommend this clinic.

The clinic was clean, and everything went smoothly. The staff were all wonderful, from the receptionist to the vet and technicians. They were kind, caring, and quick to help when we were worried about HeiMei. The vet even followed up with us to check how he was doing, which meant a lot to us. We’re truly grateful for all their help and care. Highly recommend this clinic!

I've been coming here for a while. And I have to say, everyone is great. The staff, the reception the technicians and the vets. I highly recommend this place. I just wanted to say my dog passed away. And they were very nice. They sent me a nice card. If I do get another dog, you can be sure that this is a place I will come to. I just want to say a big thank you to all of the staff for your condolences.💕

From the moment I walked into Royal Vet Clinique Vétérinaire – Sud Ouest, I felt that my cat Tommy was in the best possible hands. The entire team greeted us warmly, and it was immediately clear how much they genuinely care for both pets and their owners. Veterinary visits can sometimes be stressful, but they created an atmosphere of calm and professionalism that put both Tommy and me at ease.

What impressed me most was the balance they struck between medical expertise and personal attention. The veterinarians took the time to explain everything in detail, making sure I understood Tommy’s needs and the options available. They didn’t rush, they listened carefully to my concerns, and they treated Tommy as if he were their own. That level of care is rare, and it really stood out.

Tommy can sometimes be shy and a little anxious in new environments, but the staff handled him with such patience and gentleness that he quickly relaxed. They spoke to him in soothing tones, moved carefully, and always ensured he felt secure. Watching how comfortable Tommy was with them gave me a lot of confidence and peace of mind.

The clinic itself is spotless, modern, and very well equipped, which reassured me that the medical side of things is just as strong as the human side. From reception to follow-up, every detail was handled with professionalism and kindness.

I left feeling grateful not only that Tommy received excellent veterinary care, but also that we were treated like family throughout the experience. It’s rare to find a clinic where compassion and expertise blend so seamlessly.

If you’re looking for a veterinary team that will treat your pet with skill, respect, and genuine love, Royal Vet Clinique is absolutely the place to go.

Very lovely and welcoming staff! They offer coffee and tea while you wait, are very thorough with their examinations and priced fairly compared to other vets I’ve been to. Would recommend to all our furry friends:)
Well received and accompanied along for a last minute emergency.

I was looking for a vet clinic for my cat and someone I know recommended RoyalVet, the clinic it’s very clean, the staff is very nice and welcoming, the technician and the vet were very clear and informative, they answered all my questions and to finish strong the prices weren’t that bad,  pretty standard yet cheaper than other vets I called to get a quote, my cat got 2 shots and she’s scheduled for sterilization in a month, I’m comfortable with them to do the surgery, I would recommend 😊 the only thing that they could work on is the punctuality with the appointments but other than that, great service 👌🏽

I highly recommend Royal Vet Sud-Ouest. The service is fast, professional, and booking an appointment is easy. The team is responsive and welcoming, and I was very satisfied from the moment I arrived until the moment I left.
They are always so welcoming and attentive to our Ruby’s needs. Wonderful place.
The best service. Everyone working there is so kind :)

I called for an emergency appointment for my cat on a Saturday, and they were able to see us the same day. Unfortunately, to my heartbreak, it was already too late for my baby.
I was devastated. I cried what felt like all the tears in my body and honestly didn’t know what to do. Throughout one of the worst days of my life, the entire staff treated me with so much respect, compassion, and kindness. They were also incredibly gentle and loving with my baby, and I could truly feel that they cared about her.
They explained everything to me in the kindest and most compassionate way possible and made me feel heard and validated in the choices I had to make during such an unbearable moment. Even though there was nothing they could do to change the outcome, they made sure that my baby was treated with dignity and love, and that I was never made to feel alone.
I will always be grateful for the compassion they showed us on one of the hardest days of my life. Thank you.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Experience at Royal Vet – Sud-Ouest

We had such a wonderful experience with the entire team at Royal Vet – Sud-Ouest. Everyone was extremely friendly, welcoming, and made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived.

A special thank you to Dr. Sarah Bergeron, who was absolutely wonderful with Biscuit. She was so sweet, caring, patient, and amazing. She took the time to explain everything clearly and made us feel completely at ease. Most importantly, Biscuit loved her! 🐈‍⬛🍂🧡

I also really appreciated how transparent the clinic is with pricing. They provide a clear breakdown before doing anything, and they even give you a detailed breakdown of what to expect for future visits. There are no unpleasant surprises, and everything is explained clearly.

The entire team was helpful, informative, and genuinely made us feel that Biscuit was in excellent hands. The pricing is also very fair considering the quality of care and transparency.

Thank you so much to Dr. Sarah Bergeron and the entire Royal Vet – Sud-Ouest team for taking such wonderful care of Biscuit! 🍁

Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

With love and a little purr,
🐾🐈‍⬛ Biscuit 🍂🧡
Excellent service!!! The vet gave lots of good advice and the team was very professional and respectful during my cat's euthanasia.

I normally don’t leave many reviews but my experience here was so great that I felt like I had to. I just moved to Montreal with my cat from Toronto and was looking for a vet. After calling multiple locations around downtown Royal vet quoted me the cheapest for the checkup. I saw amazing reviews and decided to give it a try even though it was a bit further from me. Best decision. From the moment I walked in the staff at the front were extremely welcoming and helpful. They immediately took us into a private room, which is great for my anxious kitty. She was able to walk around and the receptionist even offered me water, tea or coffee, which was incredibly kind. After that the vet assistant came in almost immediately and sat down with us. She addressed all my concerns and really took her time and showed extreme care and genuineness. I’m used to my vet back home being in an extreme rush that I always end up leaving with questions. But here it really felt like they cared not just about my cat but about my worries too. Next the vet came in and was extremely helpful and gentle as well. My kitty was being a bit stubborn but she was able to get everything done with some treats and gentle handling. She addressed every single one of my concerns, talking through it with me and even taking the time to discuss options for treatments and medications. I am a student so money is always tight, but it was nice to have a vet that told me straight up if I could save money in certain cases. I left feeling extremely relieved and happy with the service here. I consider this my regular vet now and will only come here.
Hands down best vet in town
Lovely staff. my dog pooped on the floor and the staff were very nice to me about it. Clean and professional.

A very bad experience.

We trusted the clinic, and they let our pet suffer and still charged us a huge bill for unnecessary "treatment."

The staff doesn't even seem to like animals; they are cold and completely lacking in empathy.

I brought my puppy in for routine vaccinations. He died that same evening.

Then I was presented with an additional $400 bill for attempting to resuscitate him.

When I asked why I had to pay for this, I was told, “Sir, we’re a business. We don’t treat animals for free; we’re not a charity. We have to make a profit.”

Losing your pet just hours after a routine vaccination visit is already an indescribable pain.

Hearing this kind of response at the very moment you’ve lost your companion is, to me, profoundly inhumane.

A traumatic experience I will never forget.
Both my dogs are seen at Royal Vet Griffintown. The care is outstanding. The team is compassionate and the experience is top notch. Rosie and Mowgli are in exceptional hands whenever we go.
Heartless people charged me $1500 for my cat, and two days later his leg was dislocated again, and they wanted to charge me another $500 just for seeing it.
The staff are very attentive, my dog ​​loves them!
Very attentive staff and a beautiful space. Our dog was given much more time than we expected.
Excellent service: on time and everyone takes time to explain things.

Second visit, the staff are still incredibly attentive to the four-legged patient; you can tell they love their work and the animals they care for.

A big thank you to the whole team.

I am writing this review after one of the most traumatic experiences I have ever had with one of my pets.

I took my young cat, Gio, to Royal Vet for neutering, a common elective procedure. Gio was a healthy young cat. I expected to pick him up a few hours later, but he never made it to his surgery.

According to the explanation I received from the clinic, Gio was sedated, then went into respiratory arrest. He was subsequently intubated, and resuscitation efforts were performed, but without success.

I am aware that there is no such thing as zero risk and that death under anesthesia can, in rare cases, occur. However, in cats considered healthy, published studies report an anesthesia/sedation-related mortality rate of approximately 0.1%, and a recent study specifically examining 1,019 healthy cats anesthetized for spaying/neutering recorded only one death.

Given the extremely rare nature of what happened to Gio, the circumstances of his death, and how the situation was subsequently handled with me, I now have serious questions and suspicions regarding possible negligence. I do not claim, at this stage, to know exactly what happened, nor can I assert that any professional misconduct occurred. It is precisely for this reason that I requested his complete medical records.

I was also deeply troubled by the discussions concerning a possible necropsy. While I was in shock and simply trying to understand how my young cat could have died after being sedated for neutering, I was repeatedly told about the significant costs of a necropsy. This reaction, under the circumstances, only increased my anxiety and my loss of trust.

And as if losing my cat under these circumstances wasn't difficult enough, I was presented with a bill including charges for resuscitation efforts as I was leaving with Gio's body.

I understand that resuscitation requires staff and equipment. But, on a human level, I found it extremely difficult and insensitive to have to pay these charges when my pet had just died in their facility after the sedation they had administered.

And unfortunately, it doesn't end there. Because Gio is dead, I now have to pay for the disposal and cremation myself, in addition to living with his loss. These are expenses I obviously would never have had to bear today if I had left with the young cat alive that I entrusted to them that morning.

I find it deeply unfair to have to deal with not only the emotional consequences of what happened, but also the immediate financial consequences of his death.

I still don't know exactly why Gio died. What I do know is that I entrusted him to Royal Vet alive and seemingly healthy for a routine procedure, that he died after sedation before he was even neutered, and that the way the events and the aftermath were handled has completely destroyed my trust in this clinic.

I will never entrust one of my animals to them again.

Today, beyond my anger, it is above all an immense sense of injustice that I feel about Gio's death. He was simply supposed to be neutered and come home with me. I left this morning thinking I'd find him a few hours later, and instead, I left with his little body.

I can ask for explanations, get his file, try to understand what happened, and take whatever steps I deem necessary. But no explanation, no apology, no refund, and no amount of action can change what truly matters to me: none of it will bring back my beloved little cat.

And that's the reality I now have to live with.
Such a great experience …
Welcoming and caring staff <3

It has taken me months to be able to write this review because, despite desperately trying to get her help, we sadly lost our cat Luna shortly after our experience with this clinic.

In April, I had just given birth to my son by emergency C-section. Almost immediately after we came home, Luna became very ill. I was essentially immobile from surgery, so my husband brought her to Royal Vet. We made it extremely clear that we believed this was an emergency and pushed for the earliest possible appointment. We were assured they offered emergency services and could help her.

When my husband arrived, they ran several tests. At one point, they pulled a syringe filled with an alarming orange liquid from Luna. Naturally, we were terrified and agreed to further testing because we wanted to do absolutely everything possible to save her.

After all of that, my husband was sent home with Luna, no diagnosis, no real answers, and a bill of approximately $1,100.

I was furious and called the clinic the following morning demanding to understand what was happening. That was when we were told that some of the test results would take days to come back and that, given Luna’s condition, they recommended we take her to an actual emergency clinic instead.

I genuinely could not believe what I was hearing.

We had specifically brought Luna there because they represented themselves to us as providing emergency veterinary care. They knew from the beginning that her condition was urgent. If they did not have the equipment, imaging capabilities or ability to properly assess and treat a critically ill animal, we should have been told that immediately so we could have gone somewhere else without losing precious time.

I spoke with multiple people at the clinic afterward trying to get answers, and the experience only made things more upsetting. I felt that our fear and willingness to do anything for Luna resulted in an enormous bill, while we were left without the answers or urgent care we believed we were receiving.

Luna deteriorated incredibly quickly, and we lost her. We are still absolutely heartbroken. I will always wonder whether getting her to a properly equipped emergency hospital sooner could have changed what happened.

Based on our experience, I would never trust this clinic with a beloved pet again.
Good service and impeccable speed. The moderator was pleasant to speak to. My cats were scared at first, but they were reassured and everything went well.

Booking an appointment was easy, the staff were attentive, and off-street parking was available in a neighborhood where parking is nonexistent. There was no pressure when our cat passed away; we were able to take our time.

I had my cat euthanized today and we received the best service. They listened and cared about the well-being of your pet. I can't thank them enough, that's a guarantee. I'll bring my other pets to this place. Thank you so much for your support, thank you so much xxx
Peanut is watching over you too, I'm sure. Thank you.

After our amazing vet moved, This has been our new vet since they opened. I have been there with my dog and the staff is amazing. Impecable service. They take their time, they really care and it shows. Never had a vet clinic this amazing before. Referred friends here, they all say the same and keep thanking me. A friend i referred here needed surgery for his dog. It is their new vet as well. Keep up the great work. You are amazing, from the front line to the vets.
Nathalie & Precious Hope 🐕💞
Savannah Adora loved vet Sarah and her tech ( Ophelia i think was her name). Thanks again
Nathalie & Savannah Adora 💞🐕‍🦺

If you’re considering coming to this clinic, ask for Dr Banon - she’s such a gem and so kind!

I came with my grandmother to bring her cat in for an emergency visit as a first-time client, as her usual clinic was unable to see her.

We were incredibly impressed with the care we received, from the efficiency of the receptionists to Taylor, the vet tech, and finally to Dr. Banon, who was exceptionally kind and compassionate.

Unfortunately, we received some difficult news regarding the cat’s health, but Dr. Banon really took the time to thoroughly explain and walk us through different treatment options.

My grandmother was so touched by the experience that, despite the distance, she’s considering transferring her cat’s care here — and I hope she does! I’m even considering bringing my own cat here as well, especially if it means having Dr. Banon as his vet.

Thank you to the entire team for making a difficult visit a little easier with your kindness and care.
Excellent service and a warm welcome.

Fantastic veterinary clinic! The whole team is lovely, professional, and truly attentive. My little dog isn't exactly their easiest patient, but they are always incredibly patient and gentle with him. Whether it's for routine care, surgery, or follow-ups, we always feel like we're in good hands. Thank you for everything! 🐶❤️

Brought my cat for a first check up at this clinic and the service was amazing, treated with kindness, very knowledgeable doctors that explained and answered all questions and concerns, and quick efficient results! Will definitely be coming back here and would recommend it to others as well :) Thank you for your care and compassion!
Royal Vet took great care of my little Nikita. Service was fast and courteous.

The quality of service and the kindness of the staff were extraordinary, even with a scared/very anxious animal. I was truly impressed. My heart is full of gratitude.

First experience for "Mike" - an abandoned cat who was resocialized with me, and it went incredibly well, especially considering he wasn't doing well. A significant milestone reached thanks to this wonderful team. Thank you!

I just moved to Griffontown last November. In the last couple of days my  beautiful husky mix was very ill with constant diarrhea by Sunday evening it hit  every  2 hours. Saturday they told me to come over immediately no appointment. They gave me probiotic sachets and I gave her plain chicken and rice she was fine Saturday then Sunday got worse. I  had happened to take her in Friday prior to make an appointment for a separate issue for the Monday. It just so happens that she got ill between then. I called  them Monday morning in a panic and gave them the update they had extra remedy at the ready. I came right away. I gave my dog the gi paste, and probiotic food they recommended and got nearly immediate results. I’m so relieved . Thank God they were there for us in our time of need. Obviously they are now my new vets.
Quick online appointment booking, warm welcome, and proactive interaction with the technician. The veterinarian is very attentive, and the service is truly pleasant. I highly recommend them!
I came for my cat, everyone is really nice and take time to listen to you 💗
First visit for my dog, I 100% recommend this practice

Friendly staff and excellent service.
My experience has been amazing from the very first phone call to book Oreo’s sterilization appointment. Everything was explained clearly, including the surgery and all the steps involved. I felt supported and confident throughout.
Thank you for taking such great care of Oreo
